title: Sunhaven Route
_note: Worked example: a bright Game-Boy-Color-era overworld loop. Two pulse channels (lead + arpeggio harmony), a triangle bass, and a light noise-drum backbeat — exactly the 4-voice budget of the DMG/GBC hardware. AABA-ish, 16 bars, loops seamlessly. Use it as a template; replace the notes, keep the voice discipline.

tracks.name: drums
tracks._note: A standalone 'e' sets the running duration to eighths; every hit after it is an eighth note. kick on 1 & 3, snare on 2 & 4, hat on every eighth — the classic backbeat. Spans all 8 bars with a crash fill closing bars 4 and 8.
